title: Abintestate

inlines.v: ABINTEST'ATE, adjective [Latin ab and intestatus - dying without a will, from in and tester, to bear witness; W. tyst; Arm. test, witness. See Test and Testify.] In the civil law, inheriting the estate of one dying without a will.
